newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal gives Lisnave 6 bln esc guarantee.
newsitem.headline: Portugal gives Lisnave 6 bln esc guarantee.

text.p: The Portuguese state has awarded a six billion escudo guarantee to loss-making ship repairer Lisnave-Estaleiros Navais de Lisboa to ensure repayment of a restructured bond loan, the Lisbon stock exchange bulletin said.
On May 30, the state gave Lisnave a separate guarantee for 3.5 billion escudos to repay the same loan, the bulletin said.

"Conditions exist for a restructuring of the company that should make it profitable in the medium term," the bulletin said. "This would happen via the participation of an international partner with specific know-how and adequate financial capacity," it added.
Lisnave plans to restructure a loan totalling 5.998 billion escudos, divided into two series.
Series A has a total value of 3.207 billion escudos, made up of 3,214,600 bonds each with a nominal value of 997.50 escudos.
Series B has a total value of 2.791 billion escudos, made up of 3,500,000 bonds each with a nominal value of 797.50 escudos.

"The reimbursement will take place in 20 payments every six months, with the first payment due on May 15 1997, and with the nominal price of each bond falling by five percent at each six-monthly payment," the bulletin said.
The interest rate for both series will be six-month Lisbor minus 0.20 percentage points. Interest will be paid on May 15 and November 15 each year.
